subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Must canonical `agents.delete` gain durable cross-store deletion state before this cron slice lands, or may it intentionally remove cron jobs before the agent-config commit and accept that partial failure mode?
rationale: Scheduler mutation and config deletion are separate fallible stores, so choosing the permanent failure and recovery contract requires explicit ownership and operator-policy judgment.

options.title: Require durable deletion state
options.body: Record a resumable deletion phase so config conflicts or process interruption cannot leave an active agent with silently removed schedules.

options.title: Accept fail-closed deletion
options.body: Keep the current ordering, document scheduler availability as an agent-deletion prerequisite, and provide explicit recovery and upgrade proof for partially removed jobs.

options.title: Split the canonical change
options.body: Keep ordinary agent deletion unchanged and move the broader cron teardown contract into a separately reviewed canonical lifecycle change.

recommendation.title: Require durable deletion state
recommendation.body: Record a resumable deletion phase so config conflicts or process interruption cannot leave an active agent with silently removed schedules.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already defined the canonical lifecycle and durability requirements in review.
